title: Meadow sweep: device check, water-sparkle regression and sharpening hitch

completion_criteria.text: A meadow with 366 flowers stays smooth on Android and macOS without changing its look or feel
completion_criteria.check: device-pass shell benchmark on the Note 10+ at noon and at midnight: at least 590 frames in 10 s and raster p90 under 16.7 ms (spec 10.15); lab Mac VM before/after shell benchmark shows no frame-time regression against the pre-sweep build (spec 10.19)
completion_criteria.result: On merged main (d0cd3b7a, PR #261), Meadow shell benchmark, seed pinned, 10 s per case. Note 10+ (GPU thermal_pwrlevel 0, two runs alternating with the pre-fix build): noon 61.9 to 62.0 fps, raster p90 14.0 to 14.1 ms (619 to 620 frames; the pre-fix build ran 36.1 to 36.4 fps, p90 29.5 to 29.7 ms); midnight and unfocused keep-moving 61.8 to 62.0 fps. Owner's MacBook Pro (Mac16,8, 120 Hz, run in the background with approval, two runs alternating with the pre-sweep build): main noon 123.5 to 123.6 fps and midnight 123.5 fps at raster p50 3.5 to 3.6 ms, against pre-sweep 123.1 to 124.8 fps at 3.5 to 3.7 ms. Lab Mac VM: noon 59.7 to 61.9 fps at 2.2 to 3.0 ms (pre-fix 7 to 7.6 fps). Look: phone screenshots of the fix against the pre-fix build match within 2/255 at noon and exactly at midnight; live noon frames show the full glint trail; the owner judged the s100 build's look good on both platforms. Not observed: full screen and the study view were not benchmarked.

completion_criteria.text: No frame over 33 ms while the sharp scene bakes and fades in on the Note 10+ (spec 10.14)
completion_criteria.check: device-pass shell benchmark sharpeningLongestFrame under 33 ms at noon and midnight, on a phone whose GPU is not thermally capped (/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/thermal_pwrlevel reads 0)

completion_criteria.text: Water sparkles and the night overlay look as they did before the off-screen layers were removed (spec 10.20)
completion_criteria.check: deterministic screenshot harness (meadow_shots_test.dart, seed pinned) on the Note 10+: wave-1 build against main over the scene area, noon and midnight
completion_criteria.result: 2026-10-03 on the Note 10+ (SM-N975W, Impeller OpenGL ES), deterministic shot harness with the Meadow seed pinned to 20280229, reduced motion, sky clock fixed, wave-1 build ecc8675f (layered water sparkles and night overlay) against main a13cd6e4 (layer-free), scene area 0,201 to 1080,1913 px. Repeat launches of each build are identical (max 0). Noon: mean 0.002/255, 0.04% of pixels over 2, max 12. Midnight: mean 0.010/255, 0.04% over 2, max 14. A 20x amplified difference map shows only one faint water oval at noon, and at midnight a one-pixel line along the night overlay's ridge edge plus 1 to 2/255 gradient banding arcs. Judged by eye in side-by-side crops: no visible change. Not observed: animated sparkles in motion (the harness holds the scene still).

completion_criteria.text: The phone's header and bottom bar glass look as before, and the owner accepts the grouped dock glass (spec 10.16)
completion_criteria.check: screenshot diff of the header and bottom bar regions, wave-1 build against main, plus the owner's answer on the dock recorded in the sweep decisions file
completion_criteria.result: Note 10+ screenshots, seed pinned, wave-1 build (separate blurs) against main: the Today page is pixel-identical; the Meadow header and bottom bar differ only along anti-aliased edges (max 9 to 15/255, at most 2% of pixels); the dock buttons differ by a mean of 0.6 to 1.8/255, invisible side by side. The fix in PR #261 leaves the glass identical to the pre-fix build. The owner looked at the s100 build on the Note 10+ and the Mac and said: "I tested the look previously. the s100 blur version looked good."
completion_criteria.settled_by: I tested the look previously. the s100 blur version looked good.

completion_criteria.text: The owner compares scene scale 1.0, 0.85 and 0.75 on the Note 10+ and the Mac and chooses whether either platform steps down (spec 10.17)
completion_criteria.check: the owner's choice recorded in the sweep decisions file
completion_criteria.result: The owner compared seeded side-by-side builds (pre-sweep, 100%, 85%, 75%) on the Note 10+ and the Mac on 2026-10-03 and said: "The `s100` version is acceptable on both macOS and Android." Both scene-scale constants stay at 1.0; recorded in docs/specs/meadow-quality-performance.decisions.md and decision 01M42MNJJ2DT2X5GHWYFEASCRD.
completion_criteria.settled_by: The `s100` version is acceptable on both macOS and Android.

completion_criteria.text: Heat and memory over 10 minutes are reported against the pre-sweep build and the owner judges them (spec 10.18)
completion_criteria.check: device-pass heat runs (600 s noon, and 600 s unfocused keep-moving) with battery temperature, GPU thermal cap and scene image bytes, plus the owner's judgment recorded in the decisions file
completion_criteria.result: Heat runs on merged main d0cd3b7a, reported in spec section 15. Note 10+: 300 s rest at 28.5 C, 600 s noon to 36.5 C at 59.8 fps, 600 s unfocused keep-moving to 41.2 C at 59.7 fps, Android thermal status 0, GPU cap level 2 at the end with no frame-rate loss, PSS 246 to 252 MB, scene images 271 MB. Owner's MacBook Pro: 600 s noon at 111 fps and 600 s unfocused at 116 fps, thermal state nominal to fair with no pmset warning, app RSS under 178 MB, scene images 123 MB, two unexplained stalls (2.2 s, 0.85 s). Against pre-sweep on the phone: 34.5 to 41.1 C over 600 s noon at 46 fps. The owner judged the results: "Heat verdict is acceptable."

spine.active_goal: The Meadow quality and performance sweep shipped in PRs #258, #259 and #260 (spec docs/specs/meadow-quality-performance.md). Finish it by meeting the spec's device criteria 10.14 to 10.20 on the Note 10+ and the Mac: first the noon regression the 2026-10-03 device check traced to the layer-free water sparkles, then the hitch while the sharp scene fades in, then the owner's look judgments.
spine.next_step: Ask the owner to judge the heat and memory results (criterion 6; spec 10.18, results in docs/specs/meadow-quality-performance.md section 15 under "After the fix merged"). Then decide with the owner how to take on the sharpening hitch (criterion 2): on the Note 10+ the sharp bake congests the raster thread for 1.2 to 1.4 s, with 29 to 38 frames over 33 ms and the longest 134 to 183 ms; the Mac showed a 247 ms sharpening frame once. Start from MeadowStage's quick-then-sharp bake and the 300 ms opacity crossfade in lib/features/garden/scene/meadow_stage.dart, honouring the decision to pace builds by GPU feedback rather than numbers tuned to one phone.

open_risks.scope: frame rate at noon on both platforms
open_risks.text: The layer-free water sparkles (lib/features/garden/render/meadow_water_marks.dart, ImageShader plus ColorFilter srcIn per mark) cost about 16 ms of every noon frame on the Note 10+: main runs noon at 36 fps (raster p50 28.5 ms, three runs) against 47 fps before the sweep, and 61 to 62 fps with the sparkles switched off. In the lab Mac VM main runs noon at 7 to 8.5 fps and midnight at 13 to 14 fps against 61 to 62 fps before, and 60 fps with the sparkles off. The owner's real Mac was not measured.

While the sharp scene bakes and crossfades (2.1 to 2.6 s on the Note 10+) nearly every frame exceeds 33 ms; the longest was 134 to 180 ms in normal runs. The breakdown shows raster-thread congestion behind the sharp bakes (build 5 to 15 ms, raster 20 to 90 ms, the rest waiting), with the 300 ms opacity crossfade at the end.

After about 50 minutes of continuous Meadow load the Note 10+ caps its GPU (thermal_pwrlevel 2 of 0 to 4 at a 44 to 45 C battery, AP 47.6 C) while Android's thermal status still reads 0; two probes run then were 2.3 times slower, matching the lowest GPU level. Benchmarks taken on a warm phone are invalid unless thermal_pwrlevel reads 0.

In the 22-minute heat run on the owner's MacBook Pro (main d0cd3b7a, 120 Hz), the Meadow averaged 111 fps at noon and 116 fps unfocused, but logged one 2.2 s stall at noon and one 0.85 s stall unfocused, and its slowest 1% of frames rose to 16 to 17 ms against 6.5 ms in 10-second runs. No display, lock or power event was logged; macOS thermal state reached fair, with no warning. Cause unknown; not seen in short runs.

key_decisions.title: Keep the Meadow scene at 100% scale on both macOS and Android
